label: Water storage anomaly (GRACE/GRACE-FO) — trend 2018→year (Sen's slope)
colormap: Red-white-green 7 bins (red = lowest / decrease, white = middle / no change, green = highest / increase)
scale: linear, symmetric about 0 (fixed across years: 98th percentile of |slope|)
source: GFZ GravIS COST-G GRACE/GRACE-FO Level-3 TWS
basis: annual mean (Jan-Dec) of the monthly values (storage anomaly; no dry-season zeros). GRACE-FO starts Jun 2018: 2018 = 5 months (Jun, Jul, Oct-Dec), accepted via the anomaly method (threshold lowered to 5 of 12 months). Missing months are filled by the climatology-anomaly method (yearly = mean monthly climatology + mean anomaly of the observed months); a year needs >= half of the season observed unless stated otherwise.
notes: Each image = per-pixel Theil-Sen (Sen's) slope of the yearly values from 2018 through the image year (>= 3 years), in cm water/yr. brown = drier / less water, teal = wetter / more water; white = no change. No significance test is applied per pixel: with 3-8 yearly points a slope is a description of change, not proof of a trend.
